llmResponse.agenda_changes: President Díaz-Slocum announced two groups of changes: (1) Move all second reading and approvals EXCEPT bylaw 9100 (items 13.6-13.10) to consent; (2) Move Measure U addendums (items 13.4-13.5) to consent. This consolidated items 13.4 through 13.10 into the consent bundle. Item 13.11 (Board Bylaw 9100) was subsequently pulled from the agenda during discussion and moved to Policy Committee.
llmResponse.consent_vote_words: Can I have a motion to move them? So moved. Second. All in favor? Hi. Aye.
